title: 2021 Census: place of work status by census tract of work (Table 98-10-0500-01), Toronto CMA
coverage: the Toronto census metropolitan area (CMA 535), which reaches beyond the City
notes: 1227 census tracts, each with the people who had a usual place of work in it in May 2021, and those who worked at home there. A 25% sample, randomly rounded: 1636045 people with a usual place of work in all. It counts people who work there, not jobs or businesses, and leaves out people with no fixed workplace. The census ran during COVID-19, when many worked at home. Simplified to about 10 m.

jobs.label: People with a usual place of work here, 2021 (25% sample)

atHome.label: People who worked at home here, 2021 (25% sample)

title: Zoning By-law 569-2013, zoning areas, Don Mills corridor
coverage: the Don Mills corridor only (west -79.37, south 43.70, east -79.32, north 43.78)
notes: 534 zones touching the corridor box, as whole features, each with its zone and the By-law chapter it falls in. A layer reaching beyond the corridor is measured inside it only. Zoning says what a lot may be used for, not what is there. Lands still under the former municipalities' by-laws aren't in it. Not for legal purposes.

title: Street Furniture – Transit Shelter
notes: 5752 transit shelters on City streets: 5444 existing, 308 temporarily removed. A shelter isn't linked to a TTC stop: the tools match one to a stop by distance. Nothing on whether a shelter or its pad is accessible.
